title: Meatball Soup
subtitle: My childhood memories. A comforting and hearty soup perfect for any day.
directions: Mix together the ground 1 lbs pork, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp marjoram, s&p. Form into small meatballs.
In a large pot, heat some oil over medium heat. Add 1 chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add 2 cups cherry tomatoes, 1/2 can tomato sauce and 1/2 tsp paprika. Cook until tomatoes fall apart. About 15 mins.
Add the meatballs to boiling pot and cook until firm. About 10 mins.
Add 3-4 large potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks. Add 1/2 tsp crushed mexican oregano. Cook until tender. About 15 mins.
Stir in 1 can (or 1 cup frozen) green peas and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
